hifi_diffcom.config_N_warning: N:1.0 in diffcom.yaml is a reverse-sampling-step multiplier, not channel symbols
hifi_diffcom.official_awgn_convention: Channel normalization has complex energy1 (total E=N) and per-real noise variance1/(2*10^(SNR/10)); multiplying both TX and noise bysqrt2 yields project E=2N with identical SNR. Receiver normalization must be consistently inverted.
hifi_diffcom.side_information_warning: ChannelWrapper.observe stores avg_pwr calculated atTX; forward()/transpose() read it atRX. Official code explicitly assumes RX knows this float. Audit local adapter and account for or disclose this channel normalization side information.
